candidates.vulnerabilityName: Oracle E-Business Suite Manage Proxies Information Disclosure
candidates.shortDescription: Vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Manage Proxies). The supported version that is affected is 12.2. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle E-Business Suite.
